NOTE: About NITTT:

National Initiative for Technical Teachers Training (NITTT) is a Scheme initiated by AICTE and MoE to provide training for teachers working in AICTE approved Technical Institutions. An Inductee Teacher has to undergo online training of eight modules in the first phase of training.

  • Dr. Yathisha L is awarded “Shisyaru mechhidha Guru” from Negilayogi Samaja Seva trust on 29-09-2018

  • Yathisha L was awarded Best Teacher during the Academic year 2018-19 by ATME College of Engineering on the occasion of Teachers day and Engineers day Celebration 2018-19.
